rows.label: tlk70000048_02_msg0001
rows.name:
Nei's... What my wife's final
moments were like...

rows.label: tlk70000048_02_msg0002
rows.name:
I couldn't bring myself to ask before,
but Kai told me about it himself.

rows.label: tlk70000048_02_msg0003
rows.name:
She was cut down protecting the
children. Even then, Nei lied that
she was fine so they could escape.

rows.label: tlk70000048_02_msg0004
rows.name:
Kei doesn't seem to remember it. She
thinks she and Nei escaped
separately.

rows.label: tlk70000048_02_msg0005
rows.name:
Maybe that was the only way she could
keep her heart from breaking...

rows.label: tlk70000048_02_msg0006
rows.name:
I know that it's my duty as a father
to tell Kei the truth, but...

rows.label: tlk70000048_02_msg0007
rows.name:
Instead of a truth that would hurt
Kei, I find myself wanting to protect
Nei's gentle lie.

rows.label: tlk70000048_02_msg0008
rows.name: What a bad father I am...
